license.content: 原创产品宣传片：品牌“絮光”与产品“呼呼”虚构，旁白自写；底图、配乐为 AI 原创生成，音效代码合成

music.title: Huhu Lullaby
music.author: Galanty
music.attribution: Huhu Lullaby — Galanty, original score generated with Lyria 3 Pro and edited with code-synthesized sound design (CC0 1.0)
music.modifications: Generated with Google Lyria 3 Pro (lyria-3-pro-preview) from an original timeline prompt; edited by tools/production/promo-aitoy-20261013/music_build.py (one 3-bar skip on a bar line so the quiet bars and the string lift land on the sad/hug scenes, -5 dB pre-duck under narration, 230 Hz dip, NumPy-synthesized SFX: wake chime, page turns, star dings, plucks, rain bed, phone taps, bubbles; no third-party samples), then encoded to 48 kbps MP3, 48 kHz stereo (library size budget). Timed to sample S116; other films will not hit its accents.

note: 虚构品牌与产品，参数与家长端界面为示意（画面上已写明）。旁白为预先生成的 Gemini 云端配音（旁白 Leda、玩偶 Laomedeia，随包旁白种子，播放不联网）；改旁白文字后新句需要本机配音整片重配。底图（AI 生成，绘本风）以 data URI 内联在幕代码里。配乐 Huhu Lullaby（CC0，随包曲库 library:original-huhu）按本片逐字时间轴剪辑并合成音效：改节奏或换曲后音效与情绪抬升不再对齐。正文约 52.4 秒，导出时接约 4.9 秒品牌片尾
